name: blackbox-resume-carries-conversation
title: The resume flag should carry the conversation it is named for
description: Measured 2026-10-05: with --reuse-session and one --session-dir on both runs, the second run's model had no trace of the first (asked what it had done, it answered that it did not know, and the session root held two session files), while the host's own --continue/--session <file> answered the same question with the real function, test count and commit id in 15 seconds. Make the flag carry the conversation, or - if the host's RPC mode cannot be driven that way from this script - narrow the flag's name and the fixture's claim to what it does, with the reason measured rather than guessed. The claim itself was already narrowed on 2026-10-05 in README.md, README.en.md and the fixture's description.
creator: aixi
